chapters.title: Save a reusable fabric recipe
chapters.description: From Live cost, choose Save Quality & Create Costing. Review the yarn rates, overhead, margin and quantity, then save the quality and its first costing snapshot together.

chapters.title: Find a quality and review new rates
chapters.description: Search the saved-quality library for Demo. Open the rate editor, change the warp rate from Rs 125 to Rs 130/kg, review its cost impact, and save and apply the quality. Existing costing snapshots stay unchanged.

chapters.title: Reuse the saved construction
chapters.description: Open the quality library and select the saved fabric to restore its yarn recipe and costing assumptions without entering all the inputs again.
